question: Find the area of a rectangle whose length is 52 m and breadth is 9 m.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Area of a rectangle is simply the product of its length and breadth. ⇒ Area = 52 × 9 Using distribution for quick calculation: 52 × (10 − 1) ⇒ 520 − 52 = 468 **∴ The correct answer is 468 m².** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
